input.summary: Lock two balls at the left ramp, repeat it twice during Multiball for 5x playfield scoring, then cash lit spinners after completing SORCERER.

quickInfo.name: Multiball
quickInfo.summary: Two left-ramp locks start two-ball play, and another player can take a locked ball.

quickInfo.name: Playfield multiplier
quickInfo.summary: Multiball starts at 2x, and later left-ramp shots raise all playfield scoring to 3x and then 5x.

quickInfo.name: SORCERER
quickInfo.summary: Complete the standup letters to light both spinners for a large per-spin value.

quickInfo.name: Bonus X
quickInfo.summary: Complete the top A-B-C-D lanes to raise Bonus X through 2x, 4x, 6x, and 8x.

quickInfo.name: Upper-right bank
quickInfo.summary: Complete the timed three-bank for its lit value, three bonus advances, and Hold Bonus when lit.

steps.text: Shoot the left ramp to lock the first ball. Be ready if the lock saucer rejects it.
Shoot the left ramp again to start two-ball Multiball.
modeNotes: Multiball: The first two ramp shots lock balls and start two-ball play. Each player can use balls that previous players locked.
Tournament lock mod: Some events require the upper three-bank before a later lock becomes available.

steps.text: Repeat the left ramp once for 3x Playfield and again for 5x Playfield. Delay a lit spinner until 5x is secured.
After 5x is active, shoot the safest top lanes, bumpers, and other broad scoring shots.
modeNotes: Playfield multiplier: Multiball doubles scoring. The next two left-ramp shots raise it to 3x and 5x.

steps.text: If only one or two SORCERER letters remain, complete them under Multiball protection.
Rip either lit spinner at 5x. Do not force the letters or spinner from an uncontrolled feed.

fallback.title: Bonus and top play
fallback.when: Use this when the left ramp rejects balls or the tournament lock mod blocks the next lock.

steps.text: Complete A-B-C-D at the top to raise Bonus X.
Build base bonus with safer lanes and targets.
Complete the upper-right timed bank only when its target returns are controlled.
Return to the ramp after the lock is available and its feed is known.

alternatives.title: Lit-spinner conversion
alternatives.when: Use this when SORCERER is complete before Multiball starts.

steps.text: Start Multiball at the left ramp.
Shoot the left ramp twice more to raise the playfield multiplier to 5x.
Shoot either lit spinner for the multiplied per-spin value.
Lock two balls at the left ramp to start Multiball.
Make two more left-ramp shots to reach 5x Playfield.
Complete SORCERER during protected play when only a small number of letters remain.
Use the lit spinners for the largest repeatable scoring window.

playfieldReferences.label: Multiball ramp
playfieldReferences.description: Left ramp used to qualify Multiball and raise its playfield scoring multiplier.
playfieldReferences.context: Shoot the left ramp twice, then repeat it during Multiball.

playfieldReferences.label: SORCERER targets
playfieldReferences.description: Center standups that light both spinners after the full letter set is complete.

playfieldReferences.label: Lit spinners
playfieldReferences.description: Left and right spinner shots worth their largest repeatable value after SORCERER is complete.

playfieldReferences.label: Top A-B-C-D lanes
playfieldReferences.description: Top lanes that advance end-of-ball Bonus X through 2x, 4x, 6x, and 8x.

playfieldReferences.label: Upper-right three-bank
playfieldReferences.description: Timed target bank that can relight a return lane and enable later locks under a tournament modification.

techniques.name: Left-ramp repeat
techniques.instruction: Repeat the left ramp during Multiball. The first two later shots raise scoring to 3x and 5x.

cautions.issue: The lock saucer can reject the ball or let it pass through the gate.
cautions.response: Keep both flippers ready after every ramp shot. Do not assume that the lock will hold the ball.

cautions.issue: A failed ramp, a missed spinner, and center-standup rebounds can send the ball out of control.
cautions.response: Shoot the ramp from a settled ball. Attack SORCERER letters only under Multiball protection.

cautions.issue: Locks are shared and can be stolen in multiplayer games.
cautions.response: Convert a ready second lock when the ramp is safe. Do not leave a valuable lock for the next player without a scoring reason.

cautions.issue: A lit spinner can tempt an early cashout while Multiball is still at 2x or 3x.
cautions.response: Use the extra-ball protection for the two multiplier ramps first. Take the spinner after 5x unless ball separation forces a safer shot.

checkBeforePlay: Check whether the center post and its rubber are installed; tournaments often remove or de-rubber it.
Confirm whether later locks require completing the timed upper-right three-bank after the first Multiball.
Test whether the left-ramp lock saucer holds cleanly and remember that multiplayer locks are shared.
input.simpleOverview: Sorcerer uses two left-ramp locks for Multiball, then two more left-ramp shots to raise all playfield scoring from 2x to 5x. Start Multiball, reach 5x, and complete S-O-R-C-E-R only when a few letters remain before cashing the lit spinners.
input.overview: Sorcerer uses two left-ramp locks for Multiball, then two more left-ramp shots to raise all playfield scoring from 2x to 5x. Start the two-ball feature, repeat the ramp twice, then finish a nearly complete S-O-R-C-E-R set under protection. Use the resulting lit spinners for the main scoring window, while top A-B-C-D lanes and the upper-right bank build end-of-ball value around it.
